theorem lemma_4_2_4 {α x δ Q₀ U V : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (h : Approx2 α x δ a q Q₀)
    (hQ₀ : 2 * rexp 1 ≤ Q₀) (hx : 10 ≤ x) (hU : 1 ≤ U) (hV : 1 ≤ V) (hD2 : 2 ≤ U * V) :
    ((|δ| ≤ 1 / (2 * c₂) ∨ U * V ≤ Q₀ / 2) →
      ‖typeI2 α x U V‖ ≤ bound_4_50 x δ q U V + bound_4_51 x q U V) ∧
    (1 / (2 * c₂) ≤ |δ| → ∀ ε, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 →
      ‖typeI2 α x U V‖ ≤ bound_4_50 x δ q U V + bound_4_52 x δ q U V Q₀ ε) :=

note: Lean proves both cases for η₂ with a factor 3/2 on the (U+1)²V log q term, c₁ = 1+|η'|₁/(x/D) and cruder lower-order terms; it drops UV + (19/18)Q₀ ≤ x/5.6 and Q₀ ≥ 2√x. Erratum: The statement prints c_1 = 1+|eta'|_1/(2x/D), but the proof's bound (4.36) needs c_1 = 1+|eta'|_1/(x/D); with the printed value A = c_1x/2y_1 fails to cover x/2y_1+|eta'|_1/2 for y_1 > D/2 (checked by `scripts/checks/lemma_4_2_4.py`).
